text:
Nina: FYInoticed a support ticket where SSE clients show two tiny active rows around reconnects and the console attributes it to retries. seems related to yesterday's routing jitter roll.
Omar: can you share trace? any difference between SSE and WS?
Nina: trace=tr-44fa. SSE majority; a couple WS multiplexed sockets also hit it. pattern: client soft-close -> immediate reconnect -> new route claims before old session tombstone clears -> console shows duplicate small-duration session.
Faye: that matches the metric spike I saw: active-sessions-delta up for ~350ms. billing-bot: billing engine flagged 0.12% duplicate charges in that window.
billing-bot: alert: possible duplicate charge window observed 2026-03-24T09:12 - small fraction of traffic.
Omar: why does tombstone take that long? we shortened affinity splay to reduce hot-shard tail. maybe missed side-effect.
Faye: also noticed SSE clients often don't include Last-Event-ID header on reconnect which prevents our console dedupe.
Nina: proxy logs: ```
[proxy] 2026-03-24T09:12:12.001 route-claim id=cid-22 shard=eu-north ttl=50ms
[proxy] 2026-03-24T09:12:12.180 session-close id=cid-22 code=1000
[client] 2026-03-24T09:12:12.195 reconnect id=cid-22 new-shard=eu-south
[billing] 2026-03-24T09:12:12.220 charge-start session=cid-22
[billing] 2026-03-24T09:12:12.410 charge-start session=cid-22-2
```
Omar: billing triggers on claim. two claims overlap -> two charges. We should either delay second charge until first is drained or make charging idempotent for brief windows.
Faye: delaying is risky (long-tail capacity). idempotency safer if we can identify same client. but clients without Last-Event-ID make it hard.
Nina: short-term mitigation: console can hide overlaps <500ms and annotate as "probable route swap". reduces support noise. long-term: 1) require/favor Last-Event-ID from SDKs, 2) billing idempotency by fingerprint (client-id + ip hash + UA) within 1s, 3) extend tombstone window slightly on canary.
Omar: fingerprinting has false positives (shared NATs). maybe prefer read-first-byte billing: start charge when first payload byte served. downside: delay attribution and edge cases where handshake fails.
Faye: telemetry request: add "route-claim-overlap" histogram, top-k client fingerprints causing overlaps, and flag when overlap rate >0.3%. console: add link from overlap annotation to trace timeline.
Nina: rollout plan: revert affinity splay on canary now, patch console to hide <500ms overlaps this afternoon, and open RFC for billing idempotency.
deploy-bot: canary rollback initiated by Nina at 09:28 UTC.
Omar: also add sampling for SSE reconnect headers so we can measure Last-Event-ID adoption and send SDK teams the list of offenders.
Faye: logging tweak: capture the reconnection "reason" if client sent explicit close vs network drop, helps decide idempotency heuristics.
Nina: thanks. I'll file infra tickets: INFRA-2210 revert-affinity, BILL-331 idempotent-charge-rfc, METR-901 overlap-metrics + dashboard.
Omar: one more: let's ensure this doesn't mask legit double-connections (true dup sockets). Add a secondary check: if overlap >1s, surface full sessions.
Faye: noted. We'll iterate.
